g.title: j3560156928
g.text: How's it going with the civilians?

g.title: j2746770340
g.text: Civvies are the same everywhere you get used to it in time

g.title: j879394541
g.text: Even before you sometimes I feel like people come THROUGH me
Just a face in an ICR tent wrapping wounds
But I'm part of the building

g.title: j3760528252
g.text: Yeah, but it's still gotta be exhausting.

g.title: j3240943589
g.text: Not enough coffee in the world sometimes, ¿no?

g.title: j2008728928
g.text: Not enough coffee in the world sometimes, ¿no?

g.title: j2840109078
g.text: Their vacant stares and numb pain
To them I'm a face in an ICR tent wrapping wounds
I feel like people come THROUGH me like a revolving door
And this was before YOU made it literal jajaja

g.title: j2595595104
g.text: Just because you're the tough one doesn't mean I can't care.

g.title: j1323550259
g.text: Yeah but a steady stream of coffee doesn't hurt. lol

g.title: j1622542459
g.text: It's enough to know someone has my back
Doesn't hover like Aoi, pretending to be mi mamá
Just hands me a cup and says, you good?

g.title: j1335498054
g.text: Doesn't hover like Aoi, pretending to be mi mamá
Just hands me a cup and says, you good?

g.title: j4158000981
g.text: I mean, what were you expecting from people who just lost everything?

g.title: j253211877
g.text: I can see why all the people turn into a blur after a while.

g.title: j4218700387
g.text: At least you're a really sexy door. :P

g.title: j1912599483
g.text: Sí, it isn't their fault there is always more of them
Always thought it was never ending
Now I know it really will never end

g.title: j4060814740
g.text: Oh, babas, you know how to cheer up a lady
"Aquí yace la puerta más sexy que hayas visto."

g.title: j1575819976
g.text: Might need it from time to time
And a cup or two of coffee won't hurt either

g.title: j1912745573
g.text: We're both too busy for this

g.title: j1732785902
g.text: I'll see what I can do.
